title: Spectral Plate + Poison Strike
premise: Test whether player phasing creates a meaningful positioning advantage for Poison Strike rather than assuming that walking through monster hitboxes improves clear speed.

knownInputs.fact: Spectral Plate grants Phasing When Equipped.
Poison Strike has a Season 14 behavioral fix limiting its poison-pierce bonus to the attack animation.

questions.question: Can a phased player stop and attack while overlapping monster hitboxes, or only move through them?
Does player phasing ignore collision with owned summons or minions?
Does phasing materially improve the ability to place a Poison Strike attack in the center of a dense pack?
Does central seed placement materially improve poison-cloud propagation or practical clear behavior?
What defensive cost comes from deliberately occupying pack centers?

protocol: Use the same character, skill setup, weapon, zone, and comparable monster packs for both conditions.
Run a control condition without Spectral Plate and an experimental condition with Spectral Plate.
For each condition, attempt edge attacks and deliberate movement into the pack center before attacking.
Record whether movement through monsters succeeds, whether the character can stop while overlapped, and whether Poison Strike can begin from that position.
Repeat with owned summons or minions present to test allied collision separately.
Compare practical poison spread and clear behavior; record observations rather than inferred engine mechanics.
Record survivability effects separately from clear behavior, including obvious increases in simultaneous incoming attacks.
